t: NixOS as Your Digital Home: Safe System Pruning with AI Collaboration
s: This article explores using NixOS as a persistent 'digital home' by treating infrastructure as code. It details safe system maintenance, specifically garbage collection, enhanced through AI collaboration to refine critical scripts for reliable, long-term system management.
sub: NixOS as a declarative, 'time-traveling' operating system with immutable filesystem
Safe NixOS system pruning and garbage collection strategies
AI collaboration for refining system maintenance scripts (Nix DSL)
Using `nix-collect-garbage --delete-older-than` for a time-based safety net
Refining a custom `n2` alias for safe NixOS system cleanup and rebuild
